help.talkBody: We read every email personally. Most replies arrive within one working day.

assessment.a: Pick the Quick Check (~3 min) for a fast level read, or the Full Test (~10 min) for a deeper picture covering sounds, real words, alien words and tricky words at every level. Results show your child's recommended level plus what they already know.

progress.q: How does my child progress through the books?
progress.a: Each book is read 5 times to build fluency, with a quick Check at the end. Pass the Check and the next book unlocks. Master every book in a level and the Level Check appears, which moves your child to the next level when passed.

stamps.a: A stamp is awarded for each unique day your child reads the current book — you can't earn two stamps in one day, the system gently asks them to come back tomorrow. Stamps 3, 4 and 5 each include a brief readiness check to confirm fluency, not just rote re-reading.

unlock.q: Can I unlock the next book manually?
unlock.a: Manual unlock is on the Parent Dashboard but currently shows "Coming soon" — we want to make sure overrides don't accidentally skip phonics gaps. If you genuinely need a book unlocked early, email us and we'll do it for you.

refunds.a: Subscriptions can be cancelled any time from your account — you keep access until the period ends. For one-time purchases (e.g. the full bundle or lifetime access), email us within 14 days for a full refund.

pwa.q: Why does my widget / home-screen app look out of date?
pwa.a: PWAs cache aggressively. Force-close the app and reopen it. If it still looks old, open the site in your browser and pull-to-refresh — the next launch will pick up the new version.
